synonyms: Gaura suffrutescens Moc. & Sessé ex Ser.
look_here_first: Think gray-hairy rhizomatous gaura: narrow foliage and stems are usually covered with appressed gray hairs, and the small pale flowers fade pink to scarlet.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis — UT specimen index under Gaura coccinea. Williamson — UT county flora lists Oenothera suffrutescens. Mason — Mason Mountain WMA flora documents Gaura coccinea.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Historical Gaura coccinea records are mapped to current Oenothera suffrutescens.

best_field_traits: gray appressed hairs on foliage and stems
small white to pink flowers often aging scarlet
fruit with thick stipe widest toward base
dry prairie and rocky grassland habit
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with O. sinuosa, O. suffrutescens is usually much grayer and hairier. Mature fruit structure is especially useful.
